codex_note:
## Native Codex execution boundary

Read the bundled upstream spec, view, report and rendering contract. Work in a task-owned scratch directory. Inspect the bundled runner and existing TypeScript, Java and TLC prerequisites before execution; its automatic mise bootstrap is not permission to alter a global environment. Use reviewed existing tools or report the precise missing prerequisite. Keep invariants agreed with the reader intact; bound the state space and report unchecked rules, model omissions and hidden transitions. Show the actual generated Mermaid statechart and each invariant counterexample. Replay code-related bug paths against the real implementation before claiming a product bug. Use the requested supported renderer; if the source-specific Pele renderer is unavailable, say so rather than inventing a rendered artifact. Native permissions and model selection remain authoritative.

The upstream workflow below supplies the detailed procedure; its host-specific tools never establish native capability or permission.
